title: AtomVersionChain
description: Ordered chain of EPR atom CIDs linked by SUPERSEDES edges, walked forward from the given start CID. Source of truth: CozoDB graph projection (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request by walking epr_edge SUPERSEDES arcs.

currentCid.description: The CID the walk starts from.

chain.description: Ordered successor CIDs (each supersedes the previous).

supersededAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this entry was superseded.

canonicalCid.description: The final (most recent) CID in the chain; null when chain is empty.
